# Last updated: 2026-05-24

## What this is

Documentation for **DefendableOS** — the third-party defense rail for
AI agents in production. Covers the HoneyBox edge appliance, the
DefendableCloud hosted-inference rail, the Defendable Agent Deed
schema, the Tribunal grading system, the doctrine pack format, and
the full architecture of how an agent task becomes a receipted deed
entry.

## Page index

  /quickstart       · 10-minute getting started · both HoneyBox and Cloud paths
  /architecture     · The 8-stage flow from agent assignment to morning brief
  /deed             · DDEED-DOV-* JSON schema reference · field-by-field
  /tribunal         · Honey / Jelly / Propolis · rule-then-judge architecture
  /doctrine-packs   · Pack format · how to contribute · pack versioning
  /honeybox         · Hardware tiers · API · setup · firmware · troubleshooting
  /cloud            · DefendableCloud API · OpenAI-SDK drop-in · model library
  /glossary         · Key terms · alphabetical · CRE-due-diligence adjacent
